Vendor Agreement

💰 Revenue Share

You receive 70% of each sale. BizHub retains 30% for platform services, payment processing, and customer support.

📅 Payout Schedule

Payouts are processed every 7 days. Minimum payout: ₦5,000. Payments are sent to your registered bank account.

📦 Product Guidelines

All products must be original or properly licensed. No illegal, harmful, or prohibited content. Accurate product descriptions are required.

⭐ Customer Satisfaction

24-hour response time to customer inquiries. 7-day refund policy for digital products. Maintain minimum 4.0 star rating.

⚠️ By accepting these terms, you agree to the revenue share model and platform guidelines.
